```{r}
#Separate features from metadata
feature_cols <- paste0("feat_", 1:120)
X <- as.matrix(df2[, feature_cols])
labels <- df2$accent
speakers <- df2$speaker_id
genders <- df2$gender

cat("Feature matrix shape:", nrow(X), "x", ncol(X), "\n")
cat("Quick stats on first 5 features:\n")
print(summary(X[, 1:5]))

```
```{r}

# Check for multi-accent speakers
speaker_ids <- unique(df2$speaker_id)
speaker_accent_list <- list()

for (sid in speaker_ids) {
  accents <- unique(df2$accent[df2$speaker_id == sid])
  speaker_accent_list[[as.character(sid)]] <- accents
}

multi_accent_ids <- c()
for (sid in names(speaker_accent_list)) {
  if (length(speaker_accent_list[[sid]]) > 1) {
    multi_accent_ids <- c(multi_accent_ids, as.integer(sid))
  }
}

cat("Speakers in 1 accent: ", length(speaker_ids) - length(multi_accent_ids), "\n")
cat("Speakers in 2+ accents:", length(multi_accent_ids), "\n\n")

if (length(multi_accent_ids) > 0) {
  cat("Multi-accent speakers:\n")
  for (sid in multi_accent_ids) {
    accents <- speaker_accent_list[[as.character(sid)]]
    n <- sum(df2$speaker_id == sid)
    cat(sprintf("  Speaker %d: %s (%d samples)\n", sid, paste(accents, collapse = ", "), n))
  }
}

# Train/test split by speaker
# Split by speaker_id so no speaker appears in both sets.
# This prevents the model from learning voice identity vs accent.
set.seed(42)

unique_speakers <- unique(speakers)
n_test <- round(length(unique_speakers) * 0.2)

test_speaker_ids <- sample(unique_speakers, n_test)
train_speaker_ids <- setdiff(unique_speakers, test_speaker_ids)

train_mask <- speakers %in% train_speaker_ids
test_mask <- speakers %in% test_speaker_ids

X_train <- X[train_mask, ]
X_test <- X[test_mask, ]
y_train <- labels[train_mask]
y_test <- labels[test_mask]
speakers_test <- speakers[test_mask]
genders_test <- genders[test_mask]

overlap <- intersect(train_speaker_ids, test_speaker_ids)
cat("Speaker overlap:", length(overlap), "(should be 0)\n")
cat("Train:", nrow(X_train), "samples,", length(train_speaker_ids), "speakers\n")
cat("Test: ", nrow(X_test), "samples,", length(test_speaker_ids), "speakers\n\n")
cat("Train accent distribution:\n")
print(table(y_train))
cat("\nTest accent distribution:\n")
print(table(y_test))
```




```{r}
# Scale features

train_means <- colMeans(X_train)
train_sds <- apply(X_train, 2, sd)
train_sds[train_sds == 0] <- 1

X_train_scaled <- scale(X_train, center = train_means, scale = train_sds)
X_test_scaled <- scale(X_test, center = train_means, scale = train_sds)

cat("Scaling complete.\n")
cat("Train scaled means (should be ~0):", round(mean(colMeans(X_train_scaled)), 6), "\n")
cat("Train scaled sds (should be ~1):  ", round(mean(apply(X_train_scaled, 2, sd)), 6), "\n")
```




```{r}
# Train one Bayesian GMM per accent
accent_classes <- sort(unique(y_train))
accent_gmms <- list()
accent_priors <- list()
total_train <- length(y_train)

for (accent in accent_classes) {
  cat("\nFitting GMM for:", accent, "...\n")

  accent_data <- X_train_scaled[y_train == accent, ]
  n_samples <- nrow(accent_data)

  accent_priors[[accent]] <- 1 / length(accent_classes)

  max_G <- min(16, floor(n_samples / 10))
  max_G <- max(max_G, 2)

  gmm_fit <- Mclust(accent_data, G = 1:max_G, modelNames = "VVI")

  accent_gmms[[accent]] <- gmm_fit

  cat("  Samples:", n_samples, "\n")
  cat("  Components selected:", gmm_fit$G, "\n")
  cat("  BIC:", round(gmm_fit$bic, 1), "\n")
  cat("  Prior:", round(accent_priors[[accent]], 4), "\n")
}

cat("\nAll GMMs trained.\n")
```

```{r}
#Predict accents on test set

predict_accent <- function(X_test, accent_gmms, accent_priors, accent_classes) {
  n_test <- nrow(X_test)
  n_classes <- length(accent_classes)

  log_scores <- matrix(0, nrow = n_test, ncol = n_classes)
  colnames(log_scores) <- accent_classes

  for (j in seq_along(accent_classes)) {
    accent <- accent_classes[j]
    gmm <- accent_gmms[[accent]]

    densities <- dens(
      modelName = gmm$modelName,
      data = X_test,
      parameters = gmm$parameters
    )

    log_likelihood <- log(densities + 1e-300)
    log_prior <- log(accent_priors[[accent]])
    log_scores[, j] <- log_likelihood + log_prior
  }

  pred_indices <- apply(log_scores, 1, which.max)
  predictions <- accent_classes[pred_indices]

  return(list(predictions = predictions, log_scores = log_scores))
}

results <- predict_accent(X_test_scaled, accent_gmms, accent_priors, accent_classes)
y_pred <- results$predictions
log_scores <- results$log_scores

cat("Predictions complete.\n")
cat("Sample predictions (first 10):\n")
print(data.frame(true = y_test[1:10], predicted = y_pred[1:10]))
```

```{r}
# Evaluation metrics
accuracy <- mean(y_pred == y_test)

cat("BAYESIAN GMM RESULTS\n")
cat("Overall accuracy:", round(accuracy, 4), "\n\n")

# Confusion matrix
cm_table <- table(Predicted = factor(y_pred, levels = accent_classes),
                  True = factor(y_test, levels = accent_classes))
cat("Confusion matrix:\n")
print(cm_table)

# Per-class precision, recall, F1
cat("\nPer-accent metrics:\n")
cat(sprintf("%-12s  Precision  Recall  F1      Support\n", "Accent"))

for (accent in accent_classes) {
  tp <- sum(y_pred == accent & y_test == accent)
  fp <- sum(y_pred == accent & y_test != accent)
  fn <- sum(y_pred != accent & y_test == accent)

  precision <- ifelse(tp + fp > 0, tp / (tp + fp), 0)
  recall <- ifelse(tp + fn > 0, tp / (tp + fn), 0)
  f1 <- ifelse(precision + recall > 0, 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), 0)
  support <- sum(y_test == accent)

  cat(sprintf("%-12s  %.4f     %.4f  %.4f  %d\n",
              accent, precision, recall, f1, support))
}

```

```{r}
#Confusion matrix heatmap
cm_matrix <- as.matrix(cm_table)

heatmap(cm_matrix,
        Rowv = NA, Colv = NA,
        col = colorRampPalette(c("white", "steelblue"))(50),
        scale = "none",
        margins = c(8, 8),
        main = "Bayesian GMM - Confusion Matrix (Counts)")
```
